verdict.rationale: BILL supports custom approval policies and budget/card limits per user, and markets S&E transactions as 'automatically compliant,' which maps to policy-based auto-approval; there's also a defined 'approval policy' concept controlling who must approve and when. However, the detailed approval-policy documentation (docs-39) is scoped to AP bill approvals rather than S&E card/expense transactions specifically, and no evidence describes granular rule-building by category+role+context or explicit exception-routing logic for expenses. Missing for 10: S&E-specific policy configuration docs (category/role/context rule builder), explicit auto-approve vs. exception-routing mechanics, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
